name: fast-clef-compaction
description: Verbatim Clef-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions, on a local Ollama or any System One server.

apiKey.title: System One API key
apiKey.description: Bearer token for the System One endpoint. Leave unset for a local Ollama; set it (or SYSTEMONE_API_KEY) for a hosted server such as TypeSafe.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum model probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every decision request. Ollama rejects requests over 64 KiB, so keep state plus questions under about 13000 tokens there.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one decision request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when the model decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

model.title: Decision model
model.description: Model name sent to the endpoint: clef or clef-flash on Ollama, jev-latest on TypeSafe.

baseUrl.title: System One endpoint
baseUrl.description: URL of the /v1/systemone endpoint. Defaults to Ollama on this machine; set https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone (plus apiKey) for TypeSafe.
